_metadata.description: Requirements for CLI, UI, and quality-loop integration.

requirements.title: Provide CLI validation and describe commands
requirements.description: CLI manifest declares validate scenario and describe scenario commands with read/run_eligible governance and generated Connect bindings.

validation.notes: Run `vrooli scenario test proto-health` and cli-health once commands are implemented.

requirements.title: Wire proto findings into test-genie
requirements.description: test-genie receives FINDING_SOURCE_PROTO findings from the optional proto phase and preserves stable finding IDs.

validation.notes: Add test-genie phase tests that parse proto-health output and map findings to FINDING_SOURCE_PROTO.

requirements.title: Map proto findings to maturity
requirements.description: ecosystem-manager maps FINDING_SOURCE_PROTO and the proto test-genie phase to an R2 proto-health maturity dimension.

validation.notes: Add maturity map anti-drift tests for source and phase mappings.

requirements.title: Ship direct UI inspection surface
requirements.description: UI shows fleet proto-health status and per-scenario finding/surface details with loading, error, and empty states.

validation.notes: Vitest + a11y coverage for loading/error/empty and populated states.

requirements.title: Publish proto contract audit skill
requirements.description: proto-contract-audit loads through prompt-manager and delegates broader API/interoperability decisions to existing steer skills.

validation.notes: Run `prompt-manager skill read proto-contract-audit` and skill validation checks.

requirements.title: Verify generated proto artifacts in CI
requirements.description: CI runs the packages/proto generated-artifact check so committed generated files cannot drift from schema sources.

requirements.title: Use code-facts for implementation proof
requirements.description: proto-health delegates source-level proto adoption and REST endpoint proof to code-facts and maps proof status into stable proto findings.

validation.notes: Run `code-facts describe proto-health --include proto_adoption,endpoint_proofs --json` and `proto-health validate scenario proto-health --json`.

requirements.title: Report proto contract impact
requirements.description: proto-health exposes an impact command and RPC that compare a scenario's current proto surface against a git or git-control-tower baseline, classify breaking changes, and report file-level unreconciled consumers.

validation.notes: Impact service tests cover buf finding parsing, scope metadata, and unreconciled consumer derivation.
Run `proto-health impact scenario proto-health --against HEAD` and `cd packages/proto && make breaking SCENARIO=proto-health`.

requirements.title: Handoff proto surface facts to dependency analysis
requirements.description: scenario-dependency-analyzer can consume DescribeScenarioProtos for fleet graph analysis instead of re-reading descriptor images.

validation.notes: Future integration test in scenario-dependency-analyzer should prove it reads proto-health surface facts.

requirements.title: Enable semantic proto reuse search
requirements.description: A future provider can index ProtoSurface facts and suggest existing proto types for reuse.

validation.notes: Future search provider tests should prove indexed ProtoSurface facts return reusable type suggestions.

requirements.title: Ratchet warning checks after fleet migration
requirements.description: Warning-level maturity checks can be promoted after fleet migration evidence shows the warning debt is intentionally resolved.

validation.notes: Future ratchet decision should cite fleet migration evidence and rerun shared health consumers.
